quests.title: Question and Answer

dialogue.t: Alright, let's begin.

dialogue.sit: I need to swot up a little more...

dialogue.t: Okay then... Make sure you read through it carefully.
Now, please listen to my questions.
To the northwest of Mondstadt are some ruins. Legend holds that it was once a city where a tyrant ruled from his tower. It has since been occupied by Dvalin, who shelters himself there.
My question is this: What is the official name now given to these ruins by the Knights of Favonius?
Correct! The ruins are indeed called "Stormterror's Lair."
...I see you've chosen to go your own way on how to remember some of these things.
But the official name given to that place by the Knights is in fact "Stormterror's Lair."
Next question. Listen carefully.
According to knightly etiquette, what is the proper form of address to use when speaking to unknown individuals encountered within Mondstadt's borders?
Correct, "strange yet respectable traveler," or indeed "travelers," is the correct way to address those that we meet here who hail from lands beyond.
Ahem, no. The correct form is "strange yet respectable traveler." I must stress that you cannot afford to be hazy on such details as an Honorary Knight.
Now for my last question.

As I'm sure you are completely aware, the affairs of the Knights of Favonius within the city walls are currently under the management of Ms. Jean. My question, then, is: What is Ms. Jean's official title?
Precisely. Jean's role is that of "Acting Grand Master."
No. Jean's title is "Acting Grand Master," and I strongly advise you to remember it...
Alright, that was all from me. Let me see...

dialogue.sit: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogue.t: Hmm... Unfortunately, you didn't answer them all correctly.
But I think that you did a good job, considering the circumstances. Please take this.

dialogue.sit: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogue.t: Hmm... Unfortunately, you didn't answer them all correctly.
But I think that you did a good job, considering the circumstances. Please take this.
Ready?

dialogue.sit: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogue.t: You got them all correct. As expected of our Honorary Knight — such questions were no problem for you at all.
To be honest, there are some locals who can't answer some of these questions.
Please, take this as a gift.

dialogue.sit: Wow, the Knights are so strict...

dialogue.t: Hmm, I think it best that you read the Knights of Favonius Handbook again.
You are an Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius, after all. It wouldn't do if you weren't familiar with Mondstadt at all.

quests.description: Swan does everything by the book — specifically, by the Knights of Favonius Handbook. Previously, Swan wouldn’t ask anything of the Traveler, who was not a Knight then. Now that the Traveler is an Honorary Knight, Swan will sometimes quiz the Traveler concerning the contents of the Handbook.
